decisions.title: Name and evidence the pilot capital source
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject the named beneficial owner, source of funds, committed amount, term, and use restrictions?
evidenceRequirements: Capital provider legal identity and beneficial ownership
Source-of-funds and sanctions evidence
Signed facility commitment with currency, amount, term and permitted uses
residualRisks: Unlawful or unavailable capital
Undisclosed redemption, seniority or control rights

decisions.title: Name the loss bearer and maximum committed loss
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject the named first and ultimate loss bearers, maximum loss, replenishment rule, and no-guarantee disclosure?
evidenceRequirements: Signed loss-allocation and maximum-loss schedule
Board or beneficial-owner authority for the committed loss
Accounting treatment and no-guarantee disclosure
residualRisks: Loss shifted to an unauthorized party
Implicit guarantee or uncapped recourse

decisions.title: Approve the legal entities, roles and jurisdictions
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject the entity, lender or capital-provider, platform, servicer, Provider, custody, data and complaint roles in every jurisdiction?
evidenceRequirements: Signed legal memorandum covering product and regulatory classification
Entity, jurisdiction, licensing and contracting map
Privacy, sanctions, AML, tax, complaint and record-retention obligations
residualRisks: Unlicensed regulated activity
Unenforceable obligations or unlawful data processing

decisions.title: Approve custody, safeguarding and the end-to-end fund path
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject every custody, settlement, reconciliation, safeguarding, withdrawal and recovery account and authority?
evidenceRequirements: End-to-end source-to-custody-to-venue-to-settlement fund-flow diagram
Named account owners, withdrawal authorities and dual-control policy
Custodian contract, safeguarding treatment and reconciliation procedure
residualRisks: Commingling, unauthorized withdrawal or asset loss
Ledger-to-custody divergence

decisions.title: Approve production signer technology and credential governance
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject signer isolation, HSM or MPC technology, action allowlist, nonce store, rotation, revocation, destruction, recovery and address non-reuse?
evidenceRequirements: Signer architecture and privileged action threat model
Independent signer ceremony, rotation, loss and destruction exercise
Durable nonce, unknown-outcome and retired-address non-reuse evidence
residualRisks: Credential theft or signing beyond approved actions
Nonce collision, replay or uncertain-outcome duplication

decisions.title: Approve one chain, asset and bounded account topology
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject the exact production chain, asset, venue, master account, subaccount isolation, contract and finality profile?
evidenceRequirements: Exact CAIP-2 chain and asset identifier with issuer and bridge risk
Founder-controlled master and isolated subaccount ownership proof
Venue terms, finality, oracle, RPC, indexer and outage assessment
residualRisks: Wrong-chain, bridge, issuer, venue or account-control failure
Testnet evidence misrepresented as production evidence

decisions.title: Approve Providers, Traders and the initial Agent cohort
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject each named Provider, Trader and Agent under signed eligibility, KYP or KYB, sanctions, SLA, concentration and termination criteria?
evidenceRequirements: Named allowlist with identity, ownership and eligibility evidence
Provider contract, SLA, settlement and incident obligations
Agent and Trader mandate, monitoring, concentration and removal criteria
residualRisks: Fraudulent or unsuitable participant
Provider concentration, conflict or operational failure

decisions.title: Approve hard exposure and concentration caps
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject numeric total, per-Facility, per-Agent, per-Trader, per-Provider, per-asset, per-chain and daily-change caps?
evidenceRequirements: Canonical minor-unit cap schedule with currency and effective period
Stress loss and concentration analysis
Fail-closed admission, dual-control decrease and no-automatic-increase policy
residualRisks: Exposure exceeds loss capacity
Correlated concentration across Agents, Providers or assets

decisions.title: Approve first-loss, collateral and settlement waterfall
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject eligible collateral, haircuts, first-loss amount, margin treatment, liquidation rights and the exact realized-income and loss waterfall?
evidenceRequirements: Eligible collateral, valuation, haircut and custody schedule
Signed first-loss and settlement waterfall
No synthetic profit, no guaranteed return and actual-realized-income accounting proof
residualRisks: Collateral shortfall or valuation failure
Incorrect priority, synthetic income or implied guarantee

decisions.title: Approve deterministic risk, staleness and stop-loss controls
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject numeric admission, leverage, concentration, drawdown, staleness, stop-loss, REDUCE_ONLY, FLATTEN and recovery-hysteresis thresholds?
evidenceRequirements: Versioned deterministic risk policy with units, windows and data max age
Historical, stress and failure-mode validation
Protective action, dual-control recovery and venue-outage exercise
residualRisks: Loss accelerates before protective action
Stale data or automatic recovery reopens risk

decisions.title: Approve pricing, fees, tax and production accounting
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject the payer, APR or return, fees, realized-income basis, tax, disclosures, chart of accounts and reconciliation ownership?
evidenceRequirements: Versioned pricing and fee schedule with payer and calculation examples
Legal, tax and disclosure review
Production chart of accounts and custody-to-Ledger reconciliation sign-off
residualRisks: Unlawful, misleading or economically unsustainable pricing
Incorrect revenue, tax, loss or customer balance accounting

decisions.title: Approve production SLO, on-call and incident ownership
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject named 24-hour ownership, SLOs, alert thresholds, recipients, escalation, incident commander, venue and custody contacts, and exercise evidence?
evidenceRequirements: Named rota, escalation tree, SLO and notification delivery evidence
Incident runbooks for signer, venue, custody, data, reconciliation and security failures
Tabletop and live-safe exercise with closure evidence
residualRisks: No accountable responder during loss or outage
TC403-REV-P2-002 runtime alert provenance remains open

decisions.title: Obtain independent production value-path security acceptance
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject the exact content-addressed release only after independent custody, signer, Exchange, funds, infrastructure and application review has zero unresolved P0 or P1?
evidenceRequirements: Independently attributable report and attestation bound to exact artifact and policy hashes
Custody, signer, nonce, Exchange action, Tenant and funds-path penetration assessment
Finding register with zero unresolved P0 or P1 and retest evidence
residualRisks: Self-review misses critical value-path defects
RELEASE-001 external review waiver is not production assurance

decisions.title: Approve rollback, wind-down and capital-recovery procedures
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject pause, cancel, REDUCE_ONLY, FLATTEN, settlement, capital recovery, signer compromise, unknown outcome, rollback and participant notification procedures?
evidenceRequirements: Versioned rollback and wind-down plan with authority matrix
No-uncertain-retry, reconciliation and append-only correction procedure
Recovery exercise covering venue, signer, database, custody and deployment failure
residualRisks: Capital trapped or duplicated during uncertain outcome
Rollback restores code but not economic truth

decisions.title: Approve production identity, data and deployment infrastructure
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject production IdP, credentials, database, backups, disaster recovery, secrets, RPC, indexer, monitoring, privacy, retention, hosting and deployment controls?
evidenceRequirements: Production architecture and data-flow review
Identity, secrets, least privilege, RLS, backup, restore and disaster-recovery evidence
Deployment provenance, monitoring, privacy, retention and rollback acceptance
residualRisks: Sandbox controls are mistaken for production controls
Credential, data, availability or recovery failure

decisions.title: Issue an exact-release multi-owner go or no-go decision
decisions.approveRejectPrompt: Approve or reject one exact artifact, policy, chain, asset, account set, capital amount, cap schedule, participant allowlist and validity window after RV-P0-01 through RV-P0-15 are independently approved?
evidenceRequirements: All prior P0 approval records current and bound to exact evidence
Zero unresolved P0 or P1 and explicit disposition of every P2
Separate reviewed launch-policy revision and exact-release multi-owner signatures
residualRisks: Approval drift across release, policy, accounts, limits or validity period
Evidence or an earlier approval is incorrectly treated as launch authority
